main_measure.name: mean next-bar return when forecast > 0 minus mean next-bar return over all bars, pooled
main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; excess < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: up-bar share when forecast > 0 minus coin-baseline up share (binomial z)

decided_by: The Newey-West t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Spans are maximal runs of forecast > 0 inside each window; the t-statistic uses a Bartlett Newey-West variance of the influence function of (mean_in - mean_all), with autocovariances taken only within windows; an up bar is a positive next-bar return; the up-share z-test is required for confirmation.
